response.sql: SELECT original_language_id, AVG(rental_rate / rental_duration) AS avg_rate_per_day, COUNT(*) AS film_count FROM film WHERE replacement_cost >= 20.99 GROUP BY original_language_id ORDER BY film_count DESC, original_language_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Films 'at the cutoff' qualify when replacement_cost >= 20.99 (cutoff is inclusive, i.e. 'at or above'); 20.99 is not a value that would normally exist, but the direction is taken as 'at or above'.
Ties in film count are broken by original_language_id ascending (NULL group first among ties), which the request does not specify.

The NULL original_language_id group is kept as its own group; GROUP BY puts NULLs together. Since the 'missing counts last' clause applies to counts, which are never NULL, no special handling is needed.

alternatives.interpretation: Qualifying films are those with replacement_cost strictly below 20.99 (cutoff as an upper bound).
